empresas.descricao: Tech Lead and Fullstack Developer (.NET and Angular)
atividades: Acting as a Tech Lead in a team of 7 developers, assisting the
team in task development, understanding the architecture,
maintaining best practices and company conventions, performing
Code Reviews (Pull Request analysis), leading ceremonies,
and improving the development workflow. Developing the company's
product using .NET and SQL Server, with a primary focus on API integrations.
Development of new features and maintenance of existing
ones in the new CICC-SP intranet system, using ASP.NET,
SQL Server, and Angular. Architecture focused on Clean
Architecture and CQRS.
Development of new features, maintenance, and bug fixes in
SmartBus, a bus ticket sales and management system, using
ASP.NET (framework 4.6, and versions 7 and 8), SQL Server,
Angular, and RabbitMQ. I was responsible for creating two
projects from scratch, including both architecture design
and coding, aimed at processing high-volume batch data.
Both projects used Clean Architecture, one with CQRS, with
inter-project communication via RabbitMQ queues and REST.
The new systems also represented a significant improvement
in the implementation of multitenancy.
Backend development using ASP.NET 6, SQL Server, MongoDB,
RabbitMQ, and Node.js, among other technologies, in a
microservices architecture with CQRS. Worked on the SP
Diário Oficial (Official Gazette) project, where I
contributed to small projects, including developing a
PDF document generation project from scratch in NodeJS,
using RabbitMQ queues within Clean Architecture.
Development of new features, maintenance, and bug fixing
for Radar, a system providing a range of management
tools for associated entrepreneurs. We primarily used
ASP.NET Core for the APIs, Angular for the frontend,
and MySQL for the database, along with other surrounding
technologies. I also helped implement queuing using
RabbitMQ, and I was responsible for developing several
important epics as a full-stack developer.
Maintenance, bug analysis and resolution, implementation
of new features in .Net Core APIs, using CQRS, RabbitMQ
(which I helped to implement), SQL Server, and integration
with other systems. I worked in the Corporate Charges
squad/microservice, and I was the Security Champion for
the team, also participating in the Information Security
squad, working with the SI team to ensure best security
practices and address potential vulnerabilities. I had a
strong role in generating PDF payment slips and rewriting
CNAB (file for batch import of payment slips) generation
to support high-volume batch data processing.
I was one of the developers responsible for migration
and enhancement (full code rewriting) of an internal
legacy MPA system (Asp.net MVC) to SPA with Angular
and .NET Core. The project was a script and routine
control system to be requested by non-privileged users.
The front-end was redesigned for a more user-friendly
and aesthetically pleasing interface, and the back-end
was restructured to meet the new front-end requirements
and migrate to .NET Core. This was a temporary contract
that ended when the allocated hours were completed.
I was responsible for developing the front-end of the
National Customer Registry, a crucial internal system
undergoing a complete rewrite to allow various types
of queries across the entire customer database.
I designed the frontend architecture from scratch,
including both the programming logic and layout,
and coded most of it until my departure. I did not
work on the backend in this project.

empresas.descricao: Developer in .Net, .Net Core, AngularJS, and Angular
atividades: Consultancy and system development using ASP.NET
(Framework and Core), C#, SQL Server, AngularJS,
and Angular. As part of a software development
outsourcing company, I participated in the development
of several products from start to finish as a full-stack
.NET + Angular developer, also contributing to entity
modeling. Among these projects, highlights include
the post-sale control system for SalfaCorp, a major
engineering firm in Chile, an online course system,
and another complete evaluation system that allowed
for exam creation with various question types,
automatic correction for objective questions,
and teacher evaluation for subjective questions.
I initially worked on developing the company's main
proprietary product, Gepro, a system that generated
reports and flagged potential inconsistencies in the
databases of major insurers in Brazil. In this system,
which was built using Asp.net Webforms, Crystal Reports,
and MS SQL Server, I gained extensive experience in
creating and maintaining stored procedures, which served
as the source for many Crystal reports.
Later, I worked on the Portal do Corretor (Broker
Portal), an essential system for Brasil Brokers company,
used by brokers and internal administration, where
properties and clients were registered, including
potential customers with their interests and sales.
This was the project to which I dedicated the most
time in the company.
Occasionally, I also assisted on the Brasil Brokers
website from another team.
Additionally, I contributed to the initial
development of Girus, a new system similar to Gepro,
for reinsurance.
My responsibilities included error analysis,
new module and feature development, requirements
gathering with clients, and documentation writing.
Main technologies used: Asp.net, C#, and SQL Server.
Error analysis and resolution, assistance in developing
new systems, documentation writing, and manual testing.
Main technologies used: Asp.net, C#, and SQL Server.
The main client I worked for was Cultura Inglesa, where
I contributed to the development of a distance learning
portal (online courses) and maintenance of an Asp Classic system.

textoExtra: In addition to the experiences listed above, prior to these,
I completed two other internships as a developer, worked
twice in technical support, worked as a maintenance technician
at Caixa Econômica (brazilian public bank), and my first job
was as a call center agent for Tim, at the age of 18.
